1. Briefing

Toolbox talk

  • General safety, then today's targets.
  • Set up the sorting stations and sort tools by type.
  • Walkthrough of the open yard — containers, ROV assets (SIT ROV, Apache 6, Apache 7), Titan 4 manipulator and the TMS frames (4 units) — to capture dimensions and weights for the logistics and new-yard space estimate.
  • Sort warehouse items, starting with racks A & B.
